jobs.name: indexed_join
jobs.sql: SELECT a.label, b.score FROM items a JOIN items b ON b.id = a.id AND b.bucket <> 3 WHERE a.id = $1 ORDER BY b.id LIMIT 1

jobs.name: three_table_join
jobs.sql: SELECT a.id, b.score, c.label FROM items a JOIN items b ON b.id = a.id JOIN items c ON c.id = b.id WHERE a.id = $1 AND b.id = $1 AND c.id = $1 ORDER BY a.id

jobs.name: three_table_join_range
jobs.sql: SELECT a.id, b.score, c.label FROM items a JOIN items b ON b.id = a.id JOIN items c ON c.id = b.id WHERE a.id < $1 AND b.id < $1 AND c.id < $1 ORDER BY a.id

jobs.name: three_table_computed_key
jobs.sql: SELECT a.id, b.score, c.label FROM items a JOIN items b ON b.id = a.id % 10 JOIN items c ON c.id = b.id WHERE a.id = $1 AND b.id < 10 AND c.id < 10 ORDER BY a.id

jobs.name: four_table_join
jobs.sql: SELECT a.id, b.score, c.label, d.bucket FROM items a JOIN items b ON b.id = a.id JOIN items c ON c.id = b.id JOIN items d ON d.id = c.id WHERE a.id = $1 AND b.id = $1 AND c.id = $1 AND d.id = $1 ORDER BY a.id

jobs.name: three_table_left_fence
jobs.sql: SELECT a.id, b.score, c.label FROM items a JOIN items b ON b.id = a.id LEFT JOIN items c ON c.id = b.id AND c.bucket <> 3 WHERE a.id = $1 AND b.id = $1 ORDER BY a.id

jobs.name: five_table_bounded
jobs.sql: SELECT a.id,b.score,c.label,d.bucket,e.id FROM items a JOIN items b ON b.id=a.id JOIN items c ON c.id=b.id JOIN items d ON d.id=c.id JOIN items e ON e.id=d.id WHERE a.id<$1 AND b.id<$1 AND c.id<$1 AND d.id<$1 AND e.id<$1 ORDER BY a.id
